tool_description: Affordable geocoding, routing and map tile APIs. Provides accurate and scalable APIs.
name: LocationIQ
title: LocationIQ

api_list.name: Matrix
api_list.description: Computes duration of the fastest route between all pairs of supplied coordinates. Returns the durations or distances or both between the coordinate pairs. Note that the distances are not the shortest distance between two coordinates, but rather the distances of the fastest routes.

required_parameters.name: coordinates
required_parameters.description: String of format {longitude},{latitude};{longitude},{latitude}[;{longitude},{latitude} ...] or polyline({polyline}) or polyline6({polyline6}). polyline follows Google's polyline format with precision 5

optional_parameters.name: radiuses
optional_parameters.description: Limits the search to given radius in meters Radiuses array length should be same as coordinates array, eaach value separated by semi-colon. Input Value - {radius};{radius}[;{radius} ...] Radius has following format :- double >= 0 or unlimited (default)

optional_parameters.name: annotations
optional_parameters.description: Returns additional metadata for each coordinate along the route geometry.  [ true, false (default), nodes, distance, duration, datasources, weight, speed ]

optional_parameters.name: fallback_coordinate
optional_parameters.description: When using a fallback_speed, use the user-supplied coordinate (input), or the snapped location (snapped) for calculating distances. [ input (default), or snapped ]

optional_parameters.name: generate_hints
optional_parameters.description: Adds a Hint to the response which can be used in subsequent requests, see hints parameter. Input Value - true (default), false Format - Base64 String

optional_parameters.name: fallback_speed
optional_parameters.description: If no route found between a source/destination pair, calculate the as-the-crow-flies distance,  then use this speed to estimate duration. double > 0

optional_parameters.name: sources
optional_parameters.description: Use location with given index as source. [ {index};{index}[;{index} ...] or all (default) ] => index	 0 <= integer < #locations

optional_parameters.name: exclude
optional_parameters.description: Additive list of classes to avoid, order does not matter. input Value - {class}[,{class}] Format - A class name determined by the profile or none.

optional_parameters.name: destinations
optional_parameters.description: Use location with given index as destination. [ {index};{index}[;{index} ...] or all (default) ]

optional_parameters.name: bearings
optional_parameters.description:
Limits the search to segments with given bearing in degrees towards true north in clockwise direction. List of positive integer pairs separated by semi-colon and bearings array should be equal to length of coordinate array.
Input Value :- {bearing};{bearing}[;{bearing} ...] Bearing follows the following format : bearing	{value},{range} integer 0 .. 360,integer 0 .. 180

optional_parameters.name: approaches
optional_parameters.description: Keep waypoints on curb side. Input Value - {approach};{approach}[;{approach} ...] Format - curb or unrestricted (default)

api_list.name: autocomplete
api_list.description: The Autocomplete API is a variant of the Search API that returns place predictions in response to an HTTP request.  The request specifies a textual search string and optional geographic bounds.  The service can be used to provide autocomplete functionality for text-based geographic searches, by returning places such as businesses, addresses and points of interest as a user types. The Autocomplete API can match on full words as well as substrings. Applications can therefore send queries as the user types, to provide on-the-fly place predictions.

required_parameters.name: normalizecity
required_parameters.description: For responses with no city value in the address section, the next available element in this order - city_district, locality, town, borough, municipality, village, hamlet, quarter, neighbourhood - from the address section will be normalized to city. Defaults to 1 for SDKs.

optional_parameters.name: viewbox
optional_parameters.description: The preferred area to find search results.  To restrict results to those within the viewbox, use along with the bounded option. Tuple of 4 floats. Any two corner points of the box - `max_lon,max_lat,min_lon,min_lat` or `min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat` - are accepted in any order as long as they span a real box.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Limit the number of returned results. Default is 10.

optional_parameters.name: countrycodes
optional_parameters.description: Limit search to a list of countries.

optional_parameters.name: tag
optional_parameters.description: Restricts the autocomplete search results to elements of specific OSM class and type.  Example - To restrict results to only class place and type city: tag=place:city, To restrict the results to all of OSM class place: tag=place

optional_parameters.name: accept-language
optional_parameters.description: Preferred language order for showing search results, overrides the value specified in the Accept-Language HTTP header. Defaults to en. To use native language for the response when available, use accept-language=native

optional_parameters.name: bounded
optional_parameters.description: Restrict the results to only items contained with the viewbox

api_list.name: reverse
api_list.description: Reverse geocoding is the process of converting a coordinate or location (latitude, longitude) to a readable address or place name. This permits the identification of nearby street addresses, places, and/or area subdivisions such as a neighborhood, county, state, or country.

required_parameters.name: normalizecity
required_parameters.description: Normalizes village to city level data to city

required_parameters.name: lat
required_parameters.description: Latitude of the location to generate an address for.

required_parameters.name: format
required_parameters.description: Format to geocode. Only JSON supported for SDKs

required_parameters.name: lon
required_parameters.description: Longitude of the location to generate an address for.

optional_parameters.name: addressdetails
optional_parameters.description: Include a breakdown of the address into elements. Defaults to 1.

optional_parameters.name: accept-language
optional_parameters.description: Preferred language order for showing search results, overrides the value specified in the Accept-Language HTTP header. Defaults to en. To use native language for the response when available, use accept-language=native

optional_parameters.name: postaladdress
optional_parameters.description: Returns address inside the postaladdress key, that is specifically formatted for each country. Currently supported for addresses in Germany. Defaults to 0 [0,1]

optional_parameters.name: namedetails
optional_parameters.description: Include a list of alternative names in the results. These may include language variants, references, operator and brand.

optional_parameters.name: showdistance
optional_parameters.description: Returns the straight line distance (meters) between the input location and the result's location. Value is set in the distance key of the response. Defaults to 0 [0,1]

optional_parameters.name: statecode
optional_parameters.description: Adds state or province code when available to the statecode key inside the address element. Currently supported for addresses in the USA, Canada and Australia. Defaults to 0

optional_parameters.name: extratags
optional_parameters.description: Include additional information in the result if available, e.g. wikipedia link, opening hours.

api_list.name: balance
api_list.description: The Balance API provides a count of request credits left in the user's account for the day. Balance is reset at midnight UTC everyday (00:00 UTC).

api_list.name: search
api_list.description: The Search API allows converting addresses, such as a street address, into geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude). These coordinates can serve various use-cases, from placing markers on a map to helping algorithms determine nearby bus stops. This process is also known as Forward Geocoding.

optional_parameters.name: dedupe
optional_parameters.description: Sometimes you have several objects in OSM identifying the same place or object in reality. The simplest case is a street being split in many different OSM ways due to different characteristics. Nominatim will attempt to detect such duplicates and only return one match; this is controlled by the dedupe parameter which defaults to 1. Since the limit is, for reasons of efficiency, enforced before and not after de-duplicating, it is possible that de-duplicating leaves you with less results than requested.

optional_parameters.name: matchquality
optional_parameters.description: Returns additional information about quality of the result in a matchquality object. Read more Defaults to 0 [0,1]

optional_parameters.name: viewbox
optional_parameters.description: The preferred area to find search results.  To restrict results to those within the viewbox, use along with the bounded option. Tuple of 4 floats. Any two corner points of the box - `max_lon,max_lat,min_lon,min_lat` or `min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat` - are accepted in any order as long as they span a real box.

api_list.name: Matching
api_list.description: Matching API matches or snaps given GPS points to the road network in the most plausible way.  Please note the request might result multiple sub-traces.  Large jumps in the timestamps (> 60s) or improbable transitions lead to trace splits if a complete matching could not be found. The algorithm might not be able to match all points. Outliers are removed if they can not be matched successfully.

required_parameters.name: coordinates
required_parameters.description: String of format {longitude},{latitude};{longitude},{latitude}[;{longitude},{latitude} ...] or polyline({polyline}) or polyline6({polyline6}). polyline follows Google's polyline format with precision 5

optional_parameters.name: radiuses
optional_parameters.description: Limits the search to given radius in meters Radiuses array length should be same as coordinates array, eaach value separated by semi-colon. Input Value - {radius};{radius}[;{radius} ...] Radius has following format :- double >= 0 or unlimited (default)

optional_parameters.name: generate_hints
optional_parameters.description: Adds a Hint to the response which can be used in subsequent requests, see hints parameter. Input Value - true (default), false Format - Base64 String

optional_parameters.name: bearings
optional_parameters.description:
Limits the search to segments with given bearing in degrees towards true north in clockwise direction. List of positive integer pairs separated by semi-colon and bearings array should be equal to length of coordinate array.
Input Value :- {bearing};{bearing}[;{bearing} ...] Bearing follows the following format : bearing	{value},{range} integer 0 .. 360,integer 0 .. 180

optional_parameters.name: tidy
optional_parameters.description: Allows the input track modification to obtain better matching quality for noisy tracks. [ true, false (default) ]

optional_parameters.name: gaps
optional_parameters.description: Allows the input track splitting based on huge timestamp gaps between points. [ split (default), ignore ]

optional_parameters.name: waypoints
optional_parameters.description: Treats input coordinates indicated by given indices as waypoints in returned Match object. Default is to treat all input coordinates as waypoints. [ {index};{index};{index}... ]

optional_parameters.name: annotations
optional_parameters.description: Returns additional metadata for each coordinate along the route geometry.  [ true, false (default), nodes, distance, duration, datasources, weight, speed ]

optional_parameters.name: steps
optional_parameters.description: Returned route steps for each route leg [ true, false (default) ]

optional_parameters.name: geometries
optional_parameters.description: Returned route geometry format (influences overview and per step) [ polyline (default), polyline6, geojson ]

optional_parameters.name: exclude
optional_parameters.description: Additive list of classes to avoid, order does not matter. input Value - {class}[,{class}] Format - A class name determined by the profile or none.

optional_parameters.name: timestamps
optional_parameters.description: Timestamps for the input locations in seconds since UNIX epoch. Timestamps need to be monotonically increasing. [ {timestamp};{timestamp}[;{timestamp} ...]  integer seconds since UNIX epoch

optional_parameters.name: overview
optional_parameters.description: Add overview geometry either full, simplified according to highest zoom level it could be display on, or not at all. [ simplified (default), full, false ]

optional_parameters.name: approaches
optional_parameters.description: Keep waypoints on curb side. Input Value - {approach};{approach}[;{approach} ...] Format - curb or unrestricted (default)
